messages:
Anna: Quick heads-up — the link scanner flagged a few broken embeds in the runtime guide (KV cache section). Noticed a dead gist and some old s3 image links. Anyone currently owning runtime-guide.md?
Michael: I own the runtime guide overall, but I haven't touched that KV subsection in a while. Which files/anchors specifically?
DocsBot: Auto-scan report: 4 broken image URLs, 1 404 gist, 2 orphan anchors found in /docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md (lines roughly 420-480). See full report: https://internal.docs/reports/1765432228-scan
Anna: Path: docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md — gist referenced at the "KV cache tuning" example (old embed to gist.github.com/oldsnippet). Images are s3://redwood-assets/... that should be on CDN.
Kevin: I can do a quick PR to rehost the images to our assets bucket. For the gist, do we want to inline the code snippet instead?
Sasha: I can pick this up — will inline the gist and rehost images. Planning a tiny PR: replace gist link with inline fenced code and swap s3 URLs to https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/...
Michael: Sounds good. Please add a short changelog entry and ping me for review. Also check if this needs a ja backport (probably not — KV cache section is english-only for now).
Sasha: Will do. Drafting now — snippet to run locally: 
```bash
# find occurrences
rg "gist.github.com/oldsnippet|s3://redwood-assets/" docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md -n
# quick sed to swap s3 host
sed -i "s|s3://redwood-assets/|https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/|g" docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md
```
Sasha: Opening PR in ~15m, will add reviewers @michael and @anna, and label `docs, quick-fix`.
Anna: Nice. If you want a second pair for copy, @kevin offered to tidy alt text.
Kevin: Yep I'll check alt text and run the local preview. If CI flags the snapshot, I'll follow up with a tiny formatting PR.
Michael: Thx everyone — assign to the runtime guide codeowners and add a brief PR description with the scan link. :thumbsup:
Anna: Thanks — marking this thread resolved once PR merged. :white_check_mark:
